channel.title: RankForge SEO Blog
channel.description: Practical, plain-English guides on SEO, GEO, and browser-based tools from RankForge.

item.title: When URLs Need Encoding (and When They Don't)
item.description: Links with spaces, Arabic text or & inside a value break quietly. Learn when a URL needs percent-encoding, when it does not, and how to fix it in seconds.

item.title: What Is a Canonical URL and How to Set One
item.description: What a canonical URL is, why duplicate URLs hurt rankings, and how to add a clean self-referencing canonical tag to every page.

item.title: How to Write Headlines That Get Clicks
item.description: Your headline decides the click. Learn what makes a headline clear and specific, how long it should be, and how to test yours before you publish.

item.title: What Is Heading Structure and How to Check It
item.description: Learn why H1–H6 order matters for readers, SEO and AI systems, common mistakes to avoid, and how to check your page hierarchy in seconds.

item.title: How to Optimize Content for GEO Success in 2027
item.description: Practical steps for answer-first writing, statistics, structure and quotability so AI answer engines can cite your content in 2027.

item.title: What Is an XML Sitemap and How to Create One
item.description: Learn what an XML sitemap is, why it still matters for SEO and GEO, and how to create and submit a valid sitemap.xml.

item.title: What Is Schema Markup and How to Add It for SEO and GEO
item.description: Learn what schema markup is, why it matters for Google and AI answer engines in 2026, and how to add valid JSON-LD in minutes.

item.title: What Is an llms.txt File and Should You Add One in 2026?
item.description: Learn what an llms.txt file is, how it differs from robots.txt, when it helps with GEO, and how to create one quickly.

item.title: Open Graph Protocol: Why Your Content Looks Broken on Social Media
item.description: Learn what Open Graph tags are, why missing og:title, og:description and og:image ruin social previews, and how to fix them in minutes.

item.title: How LLMs and Answer Engines Read Webpages Differently Than Traditional Search Bots
item.description: Traditional crawlers index keywords and links. LLMs extract meaning and quotable passages. Learn the differences and how to optimise for both.

item.title: What Is a Readability Score and Why It Matters for SEO
item.description: Learn what a readability score is, the ideal range for web content, and why clear writing helps both Google and AI search.

item.title: What Is GEO? Generative Engine Optimization Explained for Beginners
item.description: A beginner guide to GEO, how it differs from SEO, and practical steps to make your content easier for AI answer tools to find and cite.

item.title: How to Do Keyword Research for Free
item.description: Learn how to find the right keywords without paid tools, using Google suggestions, Search Console, Trends and a simple spreadsheet.

item.title: On-Page SEO Checklist for Beginners
item.description: A practical on-page SEO checklist covering titles, descriptions, URLs, headings, content, images, links and speed, with tips you can apply today.

item.title: How Long Should a Meta Description Be? (With Examples)
item.description: Learn the ideal meta description length, how Google shortens snippets, and how to write descriptions that earn clicks, with good and bad examples.

item.title: What Is a Robots.txt File and How to Create One
item.description: Understand what robots.txt does, how its rules work, common examples, mistakes to avoid, and how to create and test your own file in minutes.

item.title: How to Write SEO-Friendly URL Slugs
item.description: A practical guide to URL slugs: what they are, why they matter, best practices, good and bad examples, and how to change a slug safely.

item.title: How Many Words Should a Blog Post Be? Word Count and SEO
item.description: Is there an ideal blog post length for SEO? Learn what Google says, how to choose a word count by topic, and how to check length and reading time.

item.title: What Is Keyword Density? How to Use Keywords Without Stuffing
item.description: Learn what keyword density means, why there is no perfect percentage, how to place keywords naturally, and how to check your text for overuse.

item.title: Title Case vs Sentence Case: Which Is Better for Headlines?
item.description: Compare title case and sentence case, learn the main capitalization rules, see examples, and choose the right style for titles, headings and SEO.

item.title: How to Create a Strong Password and Keep It Safe
item.description: Learn what makes a password strong, how long it should be, why you should never reuse passwords, and how to protect your website and accounts.

item.title: What Is Lorem Ipsum and When Should You Use Placeholder Text?
item.description: Learn what lorem ipsum is, where it comes from, when placeholder text helps designers, and why you should replace it before your page goes live.

item.title: What Is SEO and How Does It Work in 2026?
item.description: SEO is the practice of improving your website so search engines can find it, understand it and show it to the right people. Learn how it works in plain language.
